On Fri, Dec 9, 2022 at 12:59 PM Garth Willis <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Colleagues,
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
In brief, we are looking to engage with Tech companies to prevent and mitigate mass atrocities where 1) there are
upcoming Key Events that could create a risk of violence or mass atrocities, and 2) where tech platform engagement
could have a mitigating impact on those risks.
We (USAID and State) have been tasked by the WWhite House to separately prepare a list of up to five counties where
we believe the USG can engage with tech companies to mitigate risks of mass atrocities. We have been tasked to
send this list to the White House by COB on Tuesday 12/13. Both State and USAID pushed back that this is
unreasonable, but the deadline was set for us. After both State and USAID send their respective lists there will be
another Sub-IPC to crosswalk the two lists to create a final list of countries for inclusion.
As a group, the USAID representatives on the Sub-lPC came up with a short list of eight countries that we still need to
narrow down to five. At this point we want to make sure all the Regional Bureaus have eyes on this and can provide
their input, and ideally concurrence, prior to the Tuesday deadline.
The eight countries (in no particular order) are:
1. Burma
2. Bangladesh
3. Pakistan
4. Zimbabwe
5. Democratic Republic of Congo
6. Ethiopia
7. Mali
8. El Salvador
